FR-001.title: Chart of Accounts screen provides a Print Chart of Accounts button

FR-002.title: Screen provides an off-by-default option to include current balances

FR-003.title: Print produces a document listing every active account

FR-004.title: Document groups accounts by type in fixed order

FR-005.title: Accounts within a type section ordered by account number ascending

FR-006.title: Each row shows number, name, and system/bank indicator

FR-007.title: Balance shown per account when include-balances is on

FR-008.title: Printed balance matches the Chart of Accounts screen's figure

FR-009.title: No balance column when include-balances is off

FR-010.title: Per-account balance error shows an indicator without blocking the rest

FR-011.title: Archived accounts excluded from the document

FR-014.title: Report also available from the central Reports menu with CSV export

context: area: src/StageFright.Reports/Providers/*.cs (existing IReportProvider pattern, e.g. TrialBalanceReportProvider)
constraint: per-account balance failures isolated (HasError indicator), never break the rest of the report
constraint: reports contributed only through IReportProvider, auto-discovered via DI — no menu code needed
constraint: Print/CSV hand off to the OS default app via a temp file, never an in-app viewer
intent: Let a user print the chart of accounts, grouped by account type/number, with an optional current-balance column
expectations: Archived accounts are not included in the printed report
No combined grand-total balance figure is shown
No new persisted entity or migration — reuses the existing Account entity and balance calculation
approach: Add a Print button plus an off-by-default include-balances RadzenSwitch to ChartOfAccountsPage, backed by one new ChartOfAccountsReportProvider that reuses IAccountBalanceService for grouped, ordered, error-isolated balances. The page prints directly via IReportProviderRegistry, IPdfReportRenderer, and Process.Start (no preview modal); registering the provider in DI alone satisfies the Reports-menu and CSV story.

decisions.decision: Reuse IAccountBalanceService as the sole balance source for the report
decisions.why: Guarantees FR-008 (matches screen figure) by construction and reuses its existing per-account HasError isolation (FR-010) instead of re-deriving GL sums
decisions.rejected: Querying IGLRepository directly in the new provider, duplicating the normal-side sign-flip and try/catch logic

decisions.decision: Print button hands off directly to a temp PDF via IReportProviderRegistry, IPdfReportRenderer, and Process.Start, bypassing ReportViewer
decisions.why: FR-013 requires the document to open automatically, matching the existing quick-print pattern used by the RehearsalList attendance roll button and other screen-level print buttons
decisions.rejected: Navigating to /reports?reportId=chart-of-accounts and triggering print from the preview modal

decisions.decision: Balance column is structurally omitted, not blank, when includeBalances is off
decisions.why: FR-009 requires no balance column at all; PdfReportRenderer and CSV export already tolerate a shorter Cells list per row so no renderer change is needed
decisions.rejected: Always including a Balance column with empty-string cells when the option is off

decisions.decision: System and bank indicator is a plain-text suffix on the Name cell
decisions.why: The spec edge case calls for plain text suitable for print rather than the on-screen badge widgets, for two rarely-set booleans

decisions.decision: DisplayOrder is set to 15, between Income Statement (10) and Trial Balance (20)
decisions.why: Keeps the existing Finance DisplayOrder sequence meaningful without renumbering any existing provider
decisions.rejected: Appending at DisplayOrder 70, the end of the Finance list

plan.summary: Plan complete: one new ChartOfAccountsReportProvider plus a Print button and switch on ChartOfAccountsPage, reusing IAccountBalanceService and the existing quick-print temp-file pattern; no new entity or migration
plan.key_finding: AccountBalanceService already provides matching-figure, per-account-error-isolated balances the report can reuse verbatim, and the RehearsalList attendance-roll button is the exact precedent for a screen-level auto-opening print action outside ReportViewer
